افتعلتا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلَتَا (iftaʕalatā) /if.ta.ʕa.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلَتَا (uftuʕilatā) /uf.tu.ʕi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
